timer_notes.per_method: Synchronized FSD extraction + original detection/attribution components + additional14-source raw-likelihood diagnostic pass; CPU output copies included; image processing, feature disk writes, differences and public API checks excluded.
timer_notes.an_extra: AN extraction includes its production residual/numerical diagnostics; upstream compute_fsd does not.
timer_notes.allocator: Timed method order alternates by fixed planned case index: even upstream then AN; odd AN then upstream. The schedule is unchanged by resume. CUDA cache is retained normally, and reserved memory can include preceding method allocations. Allocated/reserved are logical PyTorch memory, not resident physical VRAM; WDDM/system-memory fallback can permit values above6GiB.
timer_notes.reference: Saved main seconds used a different timer and are not the paired method timing.
timer_notes.processed_pixels: Literal upstream and fresh AN receive the exact same RGB PIL pixels and share the recorded pixel hash. Saved main has no stored processed pixel hash; reconstruction is linked through unchanged original-byte and transformation-code hashes.
